$comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/workflow.json and commit. Every key is optional; omitted keys take the defaults shown here. Read by the tstack-delivery skills through `workflow-config`. Placeholders in title.*: {type} and {summary} are resolved by the skill from the branch; any other placeholder (e.g. {sprint}, {phase}, {branch}) is resolved by a team adapter plugin, and when none resolves it the skill asks for it in its single batched question.
